POL-CREDIT-001.rule: Outstanding balance equals posted invoice less allocated payments and valid credit notes. Days overdue are calendar dates after due date. Never infer settlement from invoice existence.

POL-FULFIL-001.rule: Report per-line ordered, shipped and outstanding quantities. Split fulfillment requires separate shipment evidence. A purchase-order ETA is not a customer delivery promise.

POL-STOCK-001.rule: Available stock equals on-hand less reservations. Escalate shortages to purchasing; do not create a purchase order in v1.

POL-COMPLAINT-001.rule: Open damaged-goods cases require evidence review and an approved transition to in_progress. Do not issue refunds or promise compensation.

POL-METRICS-001.rule: Compare matching complete periods, state the metric basis, and distinguish signed source transaction value from cash receipts or tax-adjusted revenue. Do not invent causes.

POL-FORECAST-001.rule: Forecast error equals actual minus forecast; percentage error divides by forecast. Cite run and training cutoff. Forecast creation cannot use observations beyond its cutoff.

POL-REPORT-001.rule: Show proposed title, contents, source references and operation ID. Save only after approval by the thread owner; revalidate edits, permissions and source versions on resume.

POL-RETURNS-001.rule: Use the policy effective on the stated event date. Version 1 permits 14 days through 2011-10-31; version 2 permits 30 days from 2011-11-01. This is a fictional business rule.

POL-ACCESS-001.rule: Conversation, trace and report ownership applies to every role. Knowing an ID grants no access. Employee directory excludes compensation and private HR data.

provenance: All organization, role and policy facts in this file are authored fictional extensions. Department counts are a G04 target; only five named employee design records exist at G02.
